content.title: Alamos divests Turkish unit in $470 million deal, ending $1 billion legal dispute
content.summary: Alamos will sell the Turkish unit to Tumad Madencilik Sanayi, a mining company operated by conglomerate Nurol Holding.  As part of the deal, Alamos said arbitration proceedings that its Netherlands units filed in 2021 against Turkey will remain suspended, and shall be discontinued after certain contractual milestones are reached.  Alamos has had an active presence in Turkey since 2010, according to its website.
